objective: Close the M08 dropped-frame/capture-worker-failure gap by invalidating every prior fresh screen observation at the start of a new owner-confirmed capture epoch, before Electron requests the selected OS frame, so a disappeared source or failed capture cannot leave the previous image eligible for chat context.
non_goals: Do not run a real desktop capture, Vision model, Cloud request, GPU benchmark, repeated workflow or soak test.
Do not add auto-capture, background monitoring, renderer access to raw source IDs or a new persistence path.
Do not change the 15-second TTL, owner grant lifetime, single-use behavior, Vision confidence, archive retention or scene-QA gate.
Do not change shared control transport parsing, retry semantics or response bounds.
Do not open M09 or claim the owner scene-QA accuracy/diversity gate.
contracts: A validated single-use capture grant is consumed before any capture epoch side effect.
The desktop posts the fixed payload {action: clear} to the fixed loopback /v1/perception/clear route before calling desktopCapturer for the new frame.
If prior-observation invalidation fails, the new OS frame is not requested and no snapshot is submitted.
If the selected source disappears, encoding fails or snapshot submission fails after invalidation, no previous screen observation remains eligible as fresh context.
The clear operation remains main-process only and is not exposed through preload or renderer IPC.
No new dependency, model call, local VRAM use or raw artifact is introduced.
allowed_dependencies: Existing Electron, TypeScript and repository test tooling.
acceptance_criteria: Control-client tests prove exactly one fixed POST to /v1/perception/clear with payload {action: clear}.
Desktop integration source-order tests prove grant consume precedes invalidation and invalidation precedes desktopCapturer.getSources and snapshot submission.
No renderer or preload API can invoke perception clear directly.
Desktop typecheck, production build and all desktop tests pass.
Module-brief validation, GitNexus change scan and git diff check pass.
required_test_commands: uv run --frozen python -c "import json; from jsonschema import Draft202012Validator; schema=json.load(open('docs/schemas/module-brief.schema.json', encoding='utf-8')); brief=json.load(open('docs/modules/M08-S29-capture-epoch-failure-invalidation-module-brief.json', encoding='utf-8')); Draft202012Validator(schema).validate(brief)"
